_comment: Integrations offered on the Install page. Exactly ONE integration lives in a container; installing another replaces it after a backup. Add your own in /config/integration_manager/registry.json, same shape: {"<domain>": {"name": "Display name", "repo": "owner/repo", "patch_module": "pip module the patches target", "quiet_loggers": ["loggers started at WARNING"], "log_dir": "directory under /config with the integration's log files"}}; only repo is required.
